title: 第37章 这次是真帅飞了
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 大圣沉默了两秒，然后开口：“丫头，你们这片儿，有人在偷小孩。”温栩栩一愣：“什么？！”“东南方向，离这儿大概……一里多地。”大圣像是在用自已的神通丈量距离，“一个凡人小崽子，被绳子捆着，嘴里塞着布，从一栋大房子里往外拖呢，现在已经拖到路边了，像在等什么人。”温栩栩脑子“嗡”地一下炸了。这是……绑架？！她瞬间想起青林湾的住户都是什么人，非富即贵，随便拎出来一个都是身家过亿的主儿。绑匪盯上这里的小孩，太正常了。绑回去勒索赎金，千万起步……虽然说青林湾作为别墅区治安很好。但是架不住坏人精心策划，那些绑匪，说不定还在受害者家里安插了内应……这两个绑匪在等人，应该就是在等车来接应他们吧？！“大圣，我们得报警——”话还没说完，温栩栩就感觉自已的身体猛地从床上弹了起来。她以为大圣要往门口冲。结果大圣操控着她的腿，穿上毛绒拖鞋，直接奔向了——卧室窗户！！！温栩栩瞳孔地震：“等等等等等——”晚了。大圣已经推开窗户，翻身跃了出去。温栩栩的第一视角里，地面在飞速下坠，耳边是呼呼的风声，她的手脚正抓着外墙的下水管，像只猴子一样往下蹿。三秒。只用了三秒。从三楼落到了地面，脚掌稳稳着地，连个趔趄都没有。脚上的毛绒拖鞋也没掉！温栩栩心脏都快从嗓子眼跳出来了。她刚才……是从三楼翻下来的？用下水管道？跟拍电影一样？？？“大圣！！！”温栩栩紧张的压低了声音，“我们有警察！可以报警！！专门抓坏人的！就跟你们天庭执法队一样！！！”大圣的声音在脑海里响起，带着点不耐烦，又带着点兴奋：“报警？报啊！”“你报你的警，俺老孙救俺老孙的人——又不冲突！”温栩栩一愣。对哦。她报警，大圣救人，手和腿各做各的，完全可以同时进行啊！她手忙脚乱地掏出手机，解锁屏幕，按下110——而她的两条腿，已经开始朝着东南方向狂奔。温栩栩感觉自已简直是特别忙，手和脚各管各的，已经不是能用手忙脚乱来形容了。温栩栩手指颤抖着按下110，把手机贴到耳边。“嘟——嘟——”电话接通的瞬间，她感觉自已飞起来了。真的飞起来了。大圣操控着她的身体，在青林湾的别墅区里一路狂奔。不是跑，是飞檐走壁——脚尖在围墙上轻轻一点，整个人就蹿出去三四米；手在树干上一撑，整个人就荡出去五六米。耳边的风声呼呼作响，温栩栩觉得自已像个人形火箭。“喂？110报警中心，请讲！”温栩栩死死盯着前方，努力让自已的声音听起来平稳一点：“我要报警！青林湾别墅区，东南方向，有人绑架儿童！”“绑匪正把一个小孩往外拖，嘴巴塞着布，用绳子捆着！”接线员：“具体位置能确认吗？”温栩栩：“青林湾别墅区东南方向往滨江路的岔口附近！绑匪已经把小孩拖出别墅，带到了公路边！”“我正在往那边赶！”电话那头的接线员明显愣了一下：“你正在往那边赶？你现在在什么位置？”“我……我快到了！”温栩栩说这话的时候，脚尖正踩过一栋别墅的围墙，整个人在空中划出一道弧线，稳稳落在一片草地上。“你注意安全！不要靠近！我们马上出警！”接线员的声音急促起来，“你现在立刻找个地方躲起来，千万不要被绑匪发现！那些人很危险！”“好的好的，我知道，我躲起来——”温栩栩嘴上答应得乖巧。但她根本停不下来！！！大圣完全没有减速的意思，反而越跑越快。温栩栩感觉自已的腿已经不是腿了，是两根装了马达的弹簧。“你那边怎么有风声？”接线员忽然问，“你在追人？”“呃……对，我在……我在盯梢！”温栩栩急中生智，“我找个隐蔽的地方盯着他们，等你们来！”接线员立刻着急起来，一个小姑娘去盯梢多危险啊：“你别盯梢！太危险了！赶紧躲好！”“好的好的，我躲好了——先挂了！”温栩栩一把按掉电话，因为她已经看见了——前方一百米处，公路边的阴影里，两个鬼鬼祟祟的黑影正拖着一个小男孩往一辆不起眼的面包车走。小男孩大概五六岁，被麻绳捆得结结实实，嘴里塞着一团布，小脸憋得通红，正在拼命蹬腿挣扎。温栩栩的血一下子涌上头顶。这群畜生！！！而大圣，已经操控着她的身体，像一只真正的猴子一样，悄无声息地摸了上去。没有脚步声。甚至连草叶被踩到的声音都没有。温栩栩感觉自已身形低伏，每一次落点都精准地踩在阴影里。她从来没想过，自已的身体可以这么灵活。接近到三十米左右的时候，大圣忽然停了下来。温栩栩正纳闷，就看见自已手一伸——从路边捡起一块鸡蛋大的石头。然后，手一扬。石头在空中划过一道完美的抛物线，“哐当”一声砸在五米外的垃圾桶上。金属垃圾桶发出一声巨响，在寂静的夜里格外刺耳。那两个绑匪正抱着小孩往车边走，做贼心虚，本来就紧张得要死。这一声巨响直接把他们的魂都吓飞了一半。“什么人？！”“谁？！”两人齐刷刷转头，死死盯着垃圾桶的方向，手已经摸向了腰间的什么东西——就是现在！一道影子从阴影里猛地窜出！
content_en: The Great Sage was silent for two seconds, and then said: "Girl, someone is stealing children in your area." Wen Xuxu was stunned: "What?!" "Southeast, about... more than a mile from here." The Great Sage was using his ownHe used his magical power to measure the distance. "A mortal kid, tied with a rope, with a cloth stuffed in his mouth, was dragged out of a big house. Now he has been dragged to the side of the road, as if he is waiting for someone." Wen Xuxu's head was buzzing.Is this...kidnapping?!She instantly remembered who the residents of Qinglin Bay were. They were either rich or noble. Anyone picked out at random would have a net worth of over 100 million.It's normal for kidnappers to target children here.Tie him back and hold him for ransom, starting with tens of millions... Although Qinglin Bay is a villa area with good security.But the bad guys couldn't resist the careful planning. The kidnappers might have planted spies in the victim's house... The two kidnappers were waiting for someone. They were probably waiting for a car to pick them up, right?!"Great Sage, we have to call the police-" Before she could finish her words, Wen Xuxu felt her body jump up from the bed.She thought the Great Sage was going to rush to the door.As a result, the Great Sage controlled her legs, put on her plush slippers, and ran directly to the bedroom window!!!Wen Xuxu's pupils were shaking: "Wait, wait, wait -" It's too late.The Great Sage had already pushed open the window, turned over and jumped out.From Wen Xuxu's first-person perspective, the ground was falling rapidly, and the whistling wind could be heard in her ears. Her hands and feet were grabbing the sewer pipe on the outer wall, jumping down like a monkey.Three seconds.It only took three seconds.After falling from the third floor to the ground, the soles of his feet were firmly on the ground without even staggering.The plush slippers on my feet didn’t fall off either!Wen Xuxu's heart almost jumped out of her throat.Did she just... fall down from the third floor?Use sewer pipes?Like making a movie???"Great Sage!!!" Wen Xuxu lowered his voice nervously, "We have police! You can call the police!! Specialized in catching bad guys! Just like your Heavenly Law Enforcement Team!!!" The Great Sage's voice rang in his mind, a little impatient and a little excited: "Call the police? Call the police!" "You call the police, I am saving my grandson's people - there is no conflict!" Wen Xuxu was stunned.Yes.She called the police, the great sage rescued people, her hands and legs each did their own thing, they could all do it at the same time!She hurriedly took out her phone, unlocked the screen, and pressed 110 - and her legs had already started running towards the southeast.Wen Xuxu felt that she was extremely busy, with her hands and feet doing their own thing. It could no longer be described as being busy.Wen Xuxu pressed 110 with trembling fingers and put the phone to her ear."Beep - beep -" The moment the call was connected, she felt like she was flying.It really took off.The Great Sage controlled her body and ran all the way in the villa area of ​​Qinglin Bay.It's not running, it's walking over the wall - just tap your toes on the wall, and you'll jump three to four meters; put your hands on the tree trunk, and you'll swing five or six meters.The wind whistled in his ears, and Wen Xuxu felt like a human-shaped rocket."Hello? 110 alarm center, please speak!" Wen Xuxu stared straight ahead, trying to make her voice sound calmer: "I want to call the police! In the southeast of Qinglin Bay Villa District, someone is kidnapping a child!" "The kidnapper is dragging a child out, with a cloth stuffed in his mouth and tied with a rope!" Operator: "Can you confirm the specific location?" Wen Xuxu: "Southeast of Qinglin Bay Villa District, toward BinjiangNear the fork in the road!The kidnapper has dragged the child out of the villa and brought him to the road!"I'm rushing over there!"The operator on the other end of the phone was obviously stunned: "That's where you are heading?""I...I'm almost there!"When Wen Xuxu said this, his toes drew an arc in the air and landed firmly on the grass."Be safe! Don't come close! We'll call the police right away!" The operator's voice became urgent. "You should find a place to hide immediately. Don't be discovered by the kidnappers! Those people are very dangerous!" "Okay, okay, I know, I'll hide -" Wen Xuxu agreed obediently.But she couldn't stop at all!!!The Great Sage had no intention of slowing down at all, but instead ran faster and faster.Wen Xuxu felt that her legs were no longer legs, but two springs equipped with motors."Why is there news over there?" The operator asked suddenly, "Are you chasing someone?" "Uh... yes, I am... I'm watching!" Wen Xuxu suddenly realized, "I'll find a hidden place to keep an eye on them and wait for you to come!" The operator immediately became anxious. How dangerous it would be for a little girl to follow them: "Don'tFollow!It's too dangerous!Hurry up and hide!" "Okay, okay, I'll hide now - hang up first!" Wen Xuxu pressed the phone because she had already seen two sneaky black figures dragging an inconspicuous little boy in the shadows on the side of the road a hundred meters ahead.The little boy was about five or six years old. He was tied tightly with hemp rope and had a ball of cloth stuffed in his mouth. His little face was red from holding it back and he was kicking his legs and struggling desperately.Wen Xuxu's blood suddenly surged to the top of his head.These beasts!!!And the Great Sage had already controlled her body, touching it silently like a real monkey.There were no footsteps.Not even the sound of a blade of grass being stepped on.Wen Xuxu felt like she was lying low, and every time she landed, she stepped accurately into the shadow.She never thought that her body could be so flexible.When he got close to about thirty meters, the Great Sage suddenly stopped.Just as Wen Xuxu was wondering, he saw his hand reaching out and picking up a stone as big as an egg from the roadside.Then, he raised his hand.The stone drew a perfect parabola in the air and hit the trash can five meters away with a clang.The metal trash can made a loud noise, which was particularly harsh in the silent night.The two kidnappers were walking towards the car with the child in their arms. They felt guilty and were extremely nervous.This loud noise scared half of their souls away."Who?!" "Who?!" Both of them turned their heads and stared in the direction of the trash can. Their hands had already touched something on their waists - right now!A shadow suddenly burst out from the shadows!
